identity.label: Identity Proof
identity.description: Government-issued photo identity of the proprietor/director: Aadhaar card, PAN card, Passport, Voter ID or Driving Licence.

questions.q: Is this a government-issued identity document (Aadhaar, PAN, Passport, Voter ID or Driving Licence)?
questions.fail: This does not look like a government-issued ID.

questions.q: Is the holder's full name clearly visible?
questions.fail: The holder's name is not clearly visible.

questions.q: Is the document/ID number visible and readable?
questions.fail: The ID number is not readable.

questions.q: Are all four edges/corners of the document inside the frame?
questions.fail: The document is cropped - capture all four corners.

address.label: Address Proof
address.description: Proof of business address: recent electricity/water/telephone bill, property tax receipt, or a bank statement showing the address.

questions.q: Is this a utility bill, tax receipt, bank statement or similar document that shows a postal address?
questions.fail: This does not look like an address proof document.

questions.q: Is a complete postal address clearly visible?
questions.fail: A complete address is not visible.

questions.q: Is the document dated within the last 3 months (relative to today, {{today}})? If no date is visible answer false.
questions.fail: The document is older than 3 months or has no visible date.

extractHints.address_line: house/shop number, building, street and locality only - without city, state or PIN code
extractHints.state: Indian state or union territory name

premise.label: Premise Proof
premise.description: Proof of right to use the premises: sale deed / ownership document, registered rent or lease agreement, or NOC from the owner.

questions.q: Is this a sale deed, rent/lease agreement, ownership record or owner NOC for a property?
questions.fail: This does not look like an ownership, rent or NOC document.

questions.q: Is the property address stated and readable?
questions.fail: The property address is not readable.

questions.q: Does the document appear to carry signatures or a stamp/seal?
questions.fail: No signature or stamp is visible.

products.label: Product List
products.description: A list of food products to be manufactured, sold or handled by the business.

questions.q: Is this a list/table of food products or food categories?
questions.fail: This does not look like a food product list.

questions.q: Are the product names readable?
questions.fail: The product names are not readable.

layout.label: Layout Plan
layout.description: A floor/layout plan of the food premises showing rooms, processing areas, storage, entry/exit and dimensions.

questions.q: Is this a floor plan or layout drawing of a building/premises?
questions.fail: This does not look like a premises layout plan.

questions.q: Are the rooms/areas labelled (e.g. processing, storage, washing)?
questions.fail: Areas in the plan are not labelled.

questions.q: Are dimensions or area measurements shown?
questions.fail: No dimensions are shown.

noc.label: NOC from Local Authority
noc.description: No-Objection Certificate from the municipal corporation, panchayat, fire or other local authority.

questions.q: Is this a No-Objection Certificate or permission letter from an authority/owner?
questions.fail: This does not look like an NOC.

questions.q: Is an issuing authority name, stamp or signature visible?
questions.fail: No issuing authority, stamp or signature is visible.

importer-docs.label: Importer Documents
importer-docs.description: Importer Exporter Code (IEC) certificate or import details such as bill of entry / import licence.

questions.q: Is this an IEC certificate, bill of entry, or import licence?
questions.fail: This does not look like an IEC or import document.

questions.q: Is the IEC / reference number readable?
questions.fail: The IEC / reference number is not readable.

water-test.label: Water Test Report
water-test.description: Laboratory report of potable water analysis (chemical and microbiological) for the food premises, from an accredited lab.

questions.q: Is this a laboratory water analysis / potability test report?
questions.fail: This does not look like a water test report.

questions.q: Is the laboratory name visible?
questions.fail: The laboratory name is not visible.

questions.q: Is the sample/report date within the last 12 months (today is {{today}})? If no date is visible answer false.
questions.fail: The report is older than 12 months or undated.

authority-letter.label: Authority Letter / Board Resolution
authority-letter.description: Letter of authorisation or board resolution nominating a person to sign FSSAI applications for the company.

questions.q: Is this an authorisation letter or board resolution?
questions.fail: This does not look like an authority letter or board resolution.

questions.q: Is it signed or stamped by the company?
questions.fail: No signature or company stamp is visible.

hracc.label: HRACC Certificate
hracc.description: Hygiene Rating / HACCP-style compliance certificate for food service (HRACC / FoSTaC / audit certificate).

questions.q: Is this a hygiene/food safety compliance or training certificate (HRACC, FoSTaC, HACCP or similar)?
questions.fail: This does not look like an HRACC / food safety certificate.

questions.q: Is a validity/issue date visible and not expired relative to today ({{today}})?
questions.fail: The certificate is expired or has no visible date.

transporter-proof.label: Turnover Proof / Vehicle Declaration
transporter-proof.description: Turnover proof (ITR, CA certificate) or a vehicle declaration/RC for a food transporter.

questions.q: Is this an ITR, CA turnover certificate, vehicle RC or vehicle declaration?
questions.fail: This does not look like a turnover or vehicle document.

questions.q: Are the key figures or vehicle number readable?
questions.fail: Key figures are not readable.
